title: VEON Advances Buyback Program, Cancels Shares
body_markdown:
20 Oct 2026


#### VEON Advances Buyback Program, Cancels Shares


**New York and Dubai, October 20, 2026.** VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON), a global digital operator, today confirmed the cancellation of approximately 1.5% of its total issued shares.


Today’s cancellation of 26,951,230 common shares (equivalent to 1,078,049 ADSs) is pursuant to VEON’s ongoing share buyback program announced on September 23, 2026 to buy back and cancel 3.9% of VEON’s outstanding shares.


**About VEON**
VEON is a digital operator that provides connectivity and digital services to over 150 million connectivity and more than 228 million digital customers. Operating across five countries that are home to 550 million consumers, more than 6% of the world's population, VEON is transforming lives through technology-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth. VEON is listed on NASDAQ. For more information, visit:[https://www.veon.com](https://www.veon.com/) .
